name: 大きなフォルダーのグリッド項目
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Redesign actual Lighthouse catalog component LH15-0004, ONE folder grid tile. No page/device/board.
Image1 ORIGINAL is primary authority for folder silhouette, proportions, corners, optical weight, spacing and fine controls. Use ONLY the upper-left Work folder tile at source x47 y742 w497 h450. Preserve the filled neutral folder with its gently sloped tab and rounded corners and horizontal three-dot overflow under it. Image2 OUR MOCK supplies Japanese content and secondary layout, but its coarse sharp polygon folder needs correction from original. Image3 owner-selected card image supplies subtle neutral borders and white rounded materials only; no borrowed icons, copy or pastel circles.
Exact text: "奉仕チーム" only. Meiryo Regular14/24px, tracking0, preserve one-line title and weight. No invented metadata or heading. Logical tile width174px, top preview area about100px high, caption row below about32px. Center the recognizable folder glyph inside the upper area; label below left, three small horizontal dots below right. Preserve the source's clear thumbnail/caption relationship.
Pure #FFFFFF canvas and ordinary tile/preview surface. One rounded card with a thin neutral border and very soft shadow, compact margins. Folder and overflow coherent slate#526173, label#1D1D1D. No gray/mint wash across page, no nested icon chip, no decorative gradient/glow/gloss. Source folder is neutral and unselected; retain neutrality, no extra accent needed. Forest green primary styling does not apply because this tile contains no CTA. Do not invent a button.
Original controls disputed icon/detail choices; mock is secondary. Do not include surrounding source file previews or their colored artwork, app chrome, English, IDs or watermarks. Render entire component clearly with exact Japanese text and unclipped overflow.
reviewNotes: 原図と自作を開いて比較。自作の粗い角形フォルダーを原図の丸み・タブ形状へ修正。無選択で意味のある強調はないためスレートで統一。生成結果を目視：奉仕チーム、横三点、フォルダーを保持し白面・中立枠・柔らかい影、余計な操作なし。厳密な文字メトリクス・所有者承認・編集性・実装は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
